hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE 'src/entities/openapi/|src/assets/(i18n/)?(de|fr|it)\.json$' && { echo 'Generated file, do not edit. Regenerate with npm run api:sync:dev / api:sync:local (openapi) or npm run i18n:sync (translations); return new i18n keys for PoEditor instead.' >&2; exit 2; } || exit 0

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in */src/entities/openapi/*) ;; *.ts|*.html|*.css|*.json) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && npx --no prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0
